def min_days_to_success(n, p, q, projects):
    # Sort projects based on the ratio of money gained to experience gained
    projects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1] / x[0], reverse=True)
    
    total_experience = 0
    total_money = 0
    days = 0
    
    for a_i, b_i in projects:
        if total_experience >= p and total_money >= q:
            break
        
        # Calculate the number of days needed to gain enough experience and money from this project
        needed_experience = max(0, p - total_experience)
        needed_money = max(0, q - total_money)
        
        days_needed_for_experience = (needed_experience + a_i - 1) // a_i
        days_needed_for_money = (needed_money + b_i - 1) // b_i
        
        # Take the maximum of the two because we need to finish at least one of them
        days_needed = max(days_needed_for_experience, days_needed_for_money)
        
        # Update the total experience and money gained
        total_experience += a_i * days_needed
        total_money += b_i * days_needed
        
        # Add the days taken to the total days
        days += days_needed
    
    return days

def calculate_min_days(n, p, q, projects):
    from heapq import heappop, heappush
    
    # Initialize heap and variables
    heap = []
    total_experience = 0
    total_money = 0
    total_days = 0
    
    # Push all projects into the heap
    for ai, bi in projects:
        heappush(heap, (-ai, -bi))
    
    while True:
        # Get the most productive project
        ai, bi = heappop(heap)
        
        # Calculate the number of days needed for this project
        if total_experience >= p and total_money >= q:
            break
        
        days_needed = max((p - total_experience) / -ai, (q - total_money) / -bi)
        total_experience += int(days_needed) * -ai
        total_money += int(days_needed) * -bi
        total_days += int(days_needed)
        
        # Check if we have enough experience and money after these days
        if total_experience >= p and total_money >= q:
            break
        
        # If not, add the remaining part of the days back to the heap
        remaining_experience = (p - total_experience) % -ai
        remaining_money = (q - total_money) % -bi
        if remaining_experience > 0:
            heappush(heap, (remaining_experience, 0))
        if remaining_money > 0:
            heappush(heap, (0, remaining_money))
    
    return float(total_days)

def min_days(n, p, q, projects):
    from fractions import Fraction
    
    # Convert inputs to fractions for precise arithmetic
    p = Fraction(p)
    q = Fraction(q)
    
    # Sort projects based on the ratio of income to experience increase
    projects.sort(key=lambda x: Fraction(x[1], x[0]))
    
    total_days = Fraction(0)
    total_experience = Fraction(0)
    total_income = Fraction(0)
    
    for a_i, b_i in projects:
        # Calculate the days needed for this project to contribute enough to reach the goal
        remaining_experience = p - total_experience
        remaining_income = q - total_income
        
        if remaining_experience <= Fraction(0) and remaining_income <= Fraction(0):
            break
        
        days_needed_for_experience = max(Fraction(0), remaining_experience / a_i)
        days_needed_for_income = max(Fraction(0), remaining_income / b_i)
        
        # Choose the smaller of the two days needed
        days_to_work_on_project = min(days_needed_for_experience, days_needed_for_income)
        
        # Update totals with the chosen days
        total_days += days_to_work_on_project
        total_experience += days_to_work_on_project * a_i
        total_income += days_to_work_on_project * b_i
    
    return float(total_days)

def calculate_min_days(n, p, q, projects):
    # Sort projects by their cost-effectiveness ratio (b_i / a_i)
    projects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1] / x[0], reverse=True)
    
    total_experience = 0
    total_money = 0
    days = 0
    
    while total_experience < p or total_money < q:
        for i in range(n):
            a_i, b_i = projects[i]
            # Calculate the number of days needed to accumulate enough experience and money
            days_needed = max((p - total_experience) / a_i, (q - total_money) / b_i)
            # Update total experience and money after days_needed
            total_experience += a_i * days_needed
            total_money += b_i * days_needed
            # If we have enough experience and money, break out of the loop
            if total_experience >= p and total_money >= q:
                break
        else:
            # If no project can help, return infinity as it's impossible to meet the requirements
            return float('inf')
        
        # Increment the days count
        days += days_needed
    
    return days
